senses.gloss: (interch. with <he>הִתְעַלְפֶּה</he>, formed fr. a noun <cite ref="P00841"><he>עלפה</he></cite>, v.

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ta'anit 1:8">Tosef. Taan. I, 8</cite> <he>ולא היו מִתְעַלְּפִין עליה וכ׳</he> they did not change off (in watching) over it, but one sat &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 3b">Ḥull. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>שחט לפנינו … ולא נ׳</he> when he cut in our (the judges’) presence, without being overcome (his hand not trembling); <cite ref="Chullin 3b:8">ib.</cite> <he>שמא יִתְעַלֵּף</he> (Ar. <he>יִתְעַלְפֶּה</he>) lest his hand tremble; <cite ref="Chullin 3b:8">ib.</cite> <he>ברי לי שלא נִתְעַלַּפְתִּי</he> I am sure that my hand did not tremble.
<cite ref="Shabbat 9b:5">Sabb. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא יתעלפה</he> he may swoon (in the vapor bath).

<cite ref="Niddah 69b:28">Nidd. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא יתעלפה</he> he may be in a swoon (and not really dead). Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII <he>ומִתְעַלְּפִים</he>, v. <cite ref="P00311"><he>עוּף</he> I</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="P00838">same</cite>. Part. <cite ref="M02081"><he>מְעוּלָּף</he></cite>; f. <he>מְעוּלֶּפֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְעוּלָּפִים</he>, <he>עוּלָּפִין</he>; <he>מְאוּלָּפוֹת</he>. Mekh. B’shall. Shir., s. 6 <he>לא מוציאין ולא מכניסין מע׳ מריח הים</he> neither inhaling nor exhaling, being overcome by the smell of the sea; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 248:3">Yalk. Ex. 248</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 927">Yalk. Job 927</cite>.—
units: Cant. R. to V, 14 (ref. to מעלפת, ib.) מעולפ׳ כחן וכ׳ (through the study of the Law) the strength of man is broken, though it had been as hard as sapphires; [prob. to be read: מְעַלֶּפֶת (Pi.) it makes faint &c.].
